caption: Your AI planning looks neat but misses outcomes. These five prompts guide you from diagnosis to a reusable template. What outcome will you define first this week? #AIplanning #Productivity #Entrepreneurship

slides.title: Plans ignore outcomes
slides.body: Your AI plan looks neat but lacks measurable goals. Define success before scheduling; these five prompts will help.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose priorities
slides.body: Task: diagnose priorities from {TASK_LIST} with {DEADLINES}. Output top 3 tasks: Task, Priority (1-3), Rationale, Dependencies, Estimated Effort, Blockers.

slides.title: 2. Improve prioritization
slides.body: Task: improve prioritization using impact and urgency. From Prompt 1 top 3, assign Quadrants and revise deadlines and estimates.

slides.title: 3. Schedule with blocks
slides.body: Task: schedule prioritized tasks into 5 days with 60-minute blocks. Input: {WEEK_START_DATE}, {TIME_BLOCKS}, {PRIORITIZED_TASKS}.

slides.title: 4. Check blockers
slides.body: Task: check blockers. List 5 risks with Likelihood, Impact, and Contingencies from the proposed schedule.

slides.title: 5. Create reusable template
slides.body: Task: create a reusable weekly planning template. Output fillable sections: Goals, Top Priorities, Schedule, Risks, Contingencies, Review Prompts.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Define outcomes first, then plan. Your schedule should reflect impact, not busywork.
